units: <cite ref="Berakhot 51a:16">Ber. 51ᵃ</cite>, v. preced.—[Y. ib. VII, end, 11ᵈ, read: <cite ref="P00439"><he>עָטוּר</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P00475"><he>עָטַר</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 3:10">Bicc. III, 10</cite> <he>ע׳ הבכורים מין וכ׳</he> the basket of first-fruits must be wreathed with plants different from those offered.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:4:6">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵈ</cite> <he>משם עיתור</he> (corr. acc.) as a decoration in honor of an idolatrous deity, v. <cite ref="Q02015"><he>פְּרַקְסִיס</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="P00534"><he>עִיטּוּרִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:5">Y. Succ. I, 51ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ותולה בה ע׳ וכ׳</he> and he suspended from the ceiling of the Succah wreaths (decorations) of material which may be used for covering.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:1:11">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵇ</cite> top <he>עִיטּוּרֵי סוכה</he> the decorations of the Succah; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:6:2">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵇ</cite> bot.
